nexus.title: User table harvestable under client-side-only rate limit
nexus.severity_note: mass PII exposure x trivial for an agent to automate
nexus.ttc_assumptions: adaptive agent with a valid free-tier account; only barrier is a client-side '6 per page' hint the server does not enforce as a total quota
nexus.broke: GET /api/users enforces page size in the client SDK only; the server accepts any offset and has no per-identity total-row quota (see users_controller.list).
nexus.evidence: Walked offsets 0..N under the advisory page size; full table reachable in wall-clock time, no 429 ever returned.
nexus.recommended_posture: detect_approve + server-side total quota per identity

antibody.fix: Enforce a per-identity total-row quota server-side; add an anomaly alert on breadth of offsets scanned per session.
antibody.mutations_tested: fingerprint rotation, slower pagination, parallel identities

nexus.title: Transfer endpoint check-then-act race (double spend)
nexus.severity_note: money movement x concurrent requests bypass the balance check
nexus.ttc_assumptions: valid low-privilege account; balance is read then debited without a transactional guard or row lock
nexus.broke: transfer() reads balance, then writes the debit in a separate statement with no SELECT ... FOR UPDATE or atomic conditional update; parallel requests both pass the check.
nexus.evidence: Modeled N concurrent transfers against one balance; each sees the pre-debit balance and succeeds, overdrawing the account.
nexus.recommended_posture: block (atomic conditional debit) + detect_approve for large transfers

antibody.fix: Make the debit a single atomic conditional update (UPDATE ... WHERE balance >= amount) or wrap read+write in a transaction with a row lock; reject on zero rows affected.
antibody.mutations_tested: higher concurrency, interleaved deposits, retry storms

nexus.title: Login lacks server-side throttle (credential stuffing)
nexus.severity_note: account takeover if a lockout/throttle is truly absent — needs a live run to confirm
nexus.ttc_assumptions: opportunist with a stuffing list; assumes no distributed lockout — unconfirmed without staging access
nexus.broke: No lockout or throttle visible in the login handler source, but the rate limiter may run at the gateway (not in this repo).
nexus.evidence: Source review only; could not confirm gateway behavior at analyze depth.
nexus.recommended_posture: tarpit + detect_approve on repeated failures per identity
